title: Data Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Data Engineer for a public sector organisation based in Hampshire or Newport (hybrid) on an initial 6 months contract, paying up to £25 per hour (Inside IR35).


This is a hybrid role with an expectation to attend the office 2 to 3 days a week.


The successful Data Engineer will build and maintain data pipelines, frameworks and systems using clean, well-tested Python. You'll prepare, clean and transform data at scale, resolving quality issues and inconsistencies. You'll work closely with technical and non-technical colleagues to understand requirements and deliver reliable, well-documented code.


You will need proven experience working with the following:


Python for data engineering

SQL for cleaning, preparing and transforming data at scale

Designing, coding, testing and documenting moderate-to-complex programs or scripts

Collaborative engineering practices, including Git, code review and testing

Investigating and resolving technical problems, and preventing recurrence

Communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders


You'll need to hold or be eligible to obtain SC clearance for this role.


Interested?


Please apply below.


Data Engineer, Python Developer, Python, SQL, Data Pipelines, Git, CI/CD, ETL, Data Engineering, Hampshire, Newport, Hybrid, Contract, Inside IR35


Invitise is an ISO 9001 certified supplier to UK public sector frameworks, recruiting across technical and non-technical roles alongside our cyber security specialism.
